title: Flight Deck Operations
description: 250812-N-UJ313-1001 ATLANTIC OCEAN (Aug. 12, 2025) Pilots assigned to the “Gladiators” of Strike Fighter Squadron (VFA) 106 conduct F/A-18E Super Hornet carrier qualifications aboard the Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS George H.W.
